_comment: Paths under apps/android/ that may exist on disk without a vendor-manifest.json files[] entry.
Used by scripts/vendor-status.sh. Prefer registering Telegram-derived sources in the manifest;
allowlist is for intentional forks / third-party trees that are not tracked as per-file vendored ports.
Each entry: prefix relative to local_root (apps/android/), plus reason.

prefixes.reason: Telegram's patched AndroidX RecyclerView stack lives under :telegram for RecyclerListView. Tracked as a tree, not per-file Telegram ports.
Minimal ExoPlayer API surface / shims required by PhotoViewer/ArticleViewer video paths. Not one-to-one Telegram UI ports.
ExoPlayer UI helpers (e.g. AspectRatioFrameLayout) vendored as compile surface.
Compile-only GMS cast/vision stubs for upstream API surface; not Telegram UI ports.
Minimal Guava-facing shims required by vendored code; not per-file Telegram ports.
